final_assessment: The exploration grew from the hinge to rc13a's full scope, and it is now the stage's vehicle by the rc04 rename precedent (directory name = change name; stage from the citation). Three threads worked, each executed once per R-crc-7 and recorded as decision tables. (1) The CONCLUDED home is IN PLACE: Case 2 ran the three location-keyed readers (state.ts, orientation.ts, audit-drift) against three candidate homes and found that moving the directory defeats rc13b's fifth rung, since orientation renders the next line from the trail that moved; the record is a header token, one CONCLUDED entry with a Re-entry: slot, and a concluded: key inside the KEPT citation, with the stage-state falsehood assigned to Q-crc-11 as a known limit. (2) The grammar: H3 entries keyed by ID because domains are tables, an entry boundary at the next H1-H3, Closure with three tokens, two residual slots iff BOUNDED, nine move lines each exactly once, MALFORMED naming the line; the Decisions opener every file already writes is formalized as the ID slot (zero migration), the entry is the key (one claim per entry, no claim-level IDs, illustrative dropped), and Kind: defaults to rule so omission renders as an open rule rather than escaping. (3) rc13b inherits a FORM predicate over six entry states, a top rung that REPORTS rather than asserts (R-crc-13), and a fifth rung reading two tokens; its charter sentence is wrong by one word and is an architect handoff. The file now conforms to its own grammar: eleven decisions carry Kind:, the eight rules carry Mechanism entries with nine dispositions each, and writing D-bcs-3's entry first found the design-only residual carrier that dies at archive (FALSIFY), so the spec row owns and design points (R-crc-14). Sized at exploration: two capabilities, eight or nine requirements, tasks the only dimension at risk.
